scientific.integrity: The practical empirical innovation is solved exactly on a period-two input. The three source scale recurrences are then analyzed directly, including an exact unrolling for the quadratically weighted incremental variant.
limitations: Statement concerns the adaptive x-update rather than the complete accelerated output.
Uses the practical empirical-mean heuristic from the source paper.
No claim that the larger incremental step is uniformly beneficial.

title: A2Grad-inc has a sharp \(\sqrt{3}\) alternating-gradient scaling advantage
